name: Refresqueria & Taqueria Tropical
tagline: Tacos, barbacoa and raspas from a Marlin drive-thru.
about: Refresqueria & Taqueria Tropical at 114 Williams St in Marlin serves tacos, burritos, barbacoa and fajitas, plus raspas.
Customers like the fast drive-thru and the beef fajita taco.
